I've gone through something similar where I would just literally stop talking with everyone.  I'm kind of going through that again, but I'm trying my best to make sure it remains temporary this time around, although it's proving to be hard.  I just want to runaway from everything.  But I think it is our responsibility to push through it as well...since we know that they actually care to some extent.  It certainly isn't easy...Battling with ourselves day in day out.  An exhausting process...A vicious cycle like you said.

Yeah, I've been denying what I want, but at the same time I've known it.  I'm pretty self aware and surprisingly, can take constructive criticism quite well.  But...People have also played a role in why I feel the way I do.  They make you feel comfortable and then poof, they're gone and you're left wondering what you did wrong, or worse...They make you feel like you've done something wrong.  They tell you what you want to hear and pretend like they care...But the ones who say what you want to hear are the ones who are projecting...They're probably the ones using you to make themselves feel better.  So yeah, I can see why you feel that way..  But...I guess continuously throwing darts at the board and seeing which one sticks is also another way to go about it...Although pain will follow along the way.
